_comment: CloudFront Response Headers Policy for Toolino.
Then attach the returned policy id to your distribution's default cache behaviour:
or set it in the console under Behaviours > Edit > Response headers policy.
Two deliberate decisions are documented in deploy/cloudfront/README.md:
1. script-src includes 'unsafe-inline' because Next.js ships an inline hydration bootstrap.
Removing it requires nonce-based CSP, which needs a server or an edge function.
2. connect-src/img-src/frame-src allow the Google ad and analytics origins, which AdSense
and GA4 both require. Nothing else third-party is permitted.
Name: toolino-security-headers
Comment: HSTS, nosniff, referrer policy, permissions policy, frame options and CSP for Toolino
